title: 7 Excel Details to Check Before Sharing Data With AI
reader_task: Check what a workbook becomes as text before an AI reads it: sheets and order, headers and units, leading zeros and IDs, dates and formats, formula results, merged and blank cells, charts and other non-cell context.
scope_exclusions: Delimiters, quoting and CSV encoding belong to M06
Stored versus displayed ID analysis in depth belongs to M03-S1
Formula cache and freshness procedure belongs to M03-S2
Two-level merged header flattening belongs to M03-S3
description: Prepare Excel data for AI by checking sheets, headers, IDs with leading zeros, dates, formula results, merged cells and charts before a model reads the workbook.
description_change: Rewritten to list the seven checks; contains the primary keyword; 163 characters.
excerpt: A workbook shows you formatted values. The text an AI reads can differ. We converted a test workbook and found hidden sheets, missing zeros and changed digits.
author: DevBehindYou
